card.name: Light after cast or shed
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'light' in 'cast/shed/sheds light on', plus linking words like 'at', 'for', 'And' in science news and press-release prose.

modes.label: Shed light
modes.description: The word 'light' in the idiom of casting or shedding light on a topic.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Short words such as 'for', 'at', 'And' or 'comes' in news-style sentences about research or institutions.
modes.example: a member of the Center for Climatic Research in the Nelson Institute<< for>> Environmental Studies.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese and English fragments.
card.plain: It marks the word 'light' in 'shed light on' and some small linking words in science news stories.
